title: Clean Water Bodies and Single-Use Plastic Prohibition Bill — Public Participation and Deliberation Plan
proposal: Proposed Union Bill establishing a national water-pollution-disposal prohibition, listed single-use plastic ban and accountable public protection/restoration duties.

schedule.consultation_start: Only after verified draft, evidence register and impact notes are published
schedule.consultation_end: Not fewer than 90 days after complete publication
schedule.urgent_exception: No emergency exception for the core Bill; urgent operational measures require written necessity reasons and immediate post-action consultation/review.

participation.anti_retaliation: Confidential channel, ban on retaliation and independent complaint route.

integrity.lobbying_disclosure: Publish material meetings, funding, conflicts and draft submissions where consent/law permits
integrity.anti_capture: Published moderation rules, duplicate detection, representative outreach and separate reporting of organised campaigns
integrity.privacy: Collect minimum personal data; redact identities on request where safety risk is shown

deliberation.method: State/UT hearings plus stratified citizen panels and targeted technical sessions
deliberation.selection_safeguard: Transparent, demographically inclusive, conflict-screened process; no participant is selected solely for agreement
deliberation.moderation: Independent facilitators, published agenda and reasoned record.

response_to_comments.publication: Issue-by-issue response register before final legislative decision
response_to_comments.deadline: Before the Bill is finalised for introduction.

remedies.complaint_route: Independent accessibility/process complaint, then legislative and judicial review
remedies.reconsultation_trigger: Material evidence change, accessibility failure, manipulation, exclusion or material redraft
